description: Where the source of a finding's built file is, as the build itself says: the `source-map.json` it publishes (spec/source-map/v0.md), or, where that names nothing, a source file declaring its own published path. Advisory — it never changes what a run reports, and a finding without a mapping simply has no source location.

file.description: The source file to edit, relative to the repository root the build ran in, forward slashes. Not a site path and never absolute: the built folder does not contain it.

line.description: 1-based line in `file`, when the mapping names one. Absent means the mapping attributes the whole file and no line.

column.description: 1-based column in `file`, when the mapping names one.
